examples.text: Die Baumwolle stellt das Rückgrat der beninischen Wirtschaft dar.

glosses: Of, from, or pertaining to Benin, the Beninese people.
A person from Benin or of Beninese descent.

examples.text: “They wanted to know what part of Africa my parents hailed from,” Caesar said. “How was I to know? He said I had the nose of a Beninese.”
